issues.description: The refactored cursor path specification reads a nonexistent pa field from an IntermediatePageTableEntryView instead of its frame_pa field.
issues.rationale: path_wf compares the path guard address with cur_ancestors[i].pa, but IntermediatePageTableEntryView defines frame_pa, in_frame_index, map_to_pa, and level and has no pa field. The specification therefore cannot type-check/verify, blocking cursor contracts that require wf. Repair a1d0de0d changes the access to frame_pa and makes the path membership cases explicit.

issues.description: map promises that the cursor level is unchanged even though its descent loop lowers the level until frame.map_level().
issues.rationale: The postcondition requires self.0.level == old(self).0.level, while the implementation loops whenever the current level exceeds frame.map_level() and each push_level call decreases the level by one. A mapping that starts above its target level therefore ends the descent at the target level, contradicting the unchanged-level promise. Repair a1d0de0d removes the false equality while preserving the unchanged virtual-address and constant-field guarantees.

issues.description: The new-child map branch assumes that the allocated page-table child is the child represented by the current parent entry and cursor path before appending it.
issues.rationale: After allocating a page-table child and constructing its guard, the branch assumes path_item_points_to at lines 481-485 before push_level. Without this semantic relationship, the appended guard is not proved to be the child represented by the current parent PTE in the SPT model. Commit 6b2ae965 genuinely replaces this trust boundary with ancestors_match_path, an SPT ancestor-domain invariant, and a strengthened push_level precondition. That repair is temporary: commit 1f48716c reintroduces assume(ancestors_match_path) in the same new-child branch, and the final head retains it. B1 is counted once and is not described as durably repaired through final.
